title: Lady Gaga and Fiancé Michael Polansky Welcome Their First Child
description: Lady Gaga and her fiancé Michael Polansky have reportedly welcomed their first child together.
dek: The pop superstar steps into motherhood after years of speaking openly about her dream of having a family.
intro: Lady Gaga has entered an exciting new phase of life after reportedly welcoming her first child with fiancé Michael Polansky. The arrival marks a long-awaited milestone for the global star, who has openly shared her dreams of parenthood over the years.

sections.heading: A Dream Realized
paragraphs: News of the birth broke through reports from PEOPLE and Vogue on September 12, 2026. For Gaga, welcoming her first baby fulfills a personal aspiration she has spoken about candidly in the past, including during a 2025 appearance on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, where she shared her hope to experience motherhood.

sections.heading: A Private Partnership
paragraphs: Gaga and Polansky first connected around 2019 to 2020 before later getting engaged in 2024. While Polansky has largely kept a low profile and led a private life away from the spotlight, he has consistently stood by Gaga in support of her life and career.
Details regarding the newborn, including the baby's name and sex, have not been publicly confirmed. Representatives for Gaga did not immediately comment following the initial news reports.

closing: As the couple begins this fresh chapter together, the arrival represents a meaningful personal moment for Gaga away from the stage and bright lights.
seoTitle: Lady Gaga Welcomes First Baby With Michael Polansky
seoDescription: Lady Gaga and fiancé Michael Polansky have reportedly welcomed their first child, marking a meaningful new chapter for the couple.
